invariants.statement: A capability not explicitly granted is denied.
Ruin-class actions fail closed when classification, authority or required approval is missing.
Approval binds to the exact action/effect and becomes stale when material inputs change.

diagnostics.mechanism: deterministically compare requested operation to explicit granted capability and policy
evaluate candidate command/effect against deterministic destructive-operation packs and Rising Sea ruin rules
candidate classification only for residual semantics not covered by deterministic security mechanisms

verification_oracles.condition: operation is impossible without the required explicit capability/policy state
known destructive fixtures are denied while ordinary safe reads remain allowed

ruin_boundaries.guard: Block destructive filesystem, Git and database operations unless a specific reviewed route permits them.
Raw credentials are not exposed to untrusted execution surfaces.
No ambient authority; elevated action requires explicit bounded capability.
An action may not widen target, recipient, amount, location or write set without re-authorization.

MISSING_AUTHORITY.action: BLOCK and return the exact authority/capability required.

RUIN_CLASS.action: BLOCK or REVIEW_REQUIRED; offer a safer bounded alternative when one exists.

UNRESOLVED.action: Default deny, preserve threat/intent rivals, gather discriminating evidence without executing the risky effect.

order: retrieve prior incidents and existing security mechanisms
model trust boundary and candidate effects
compile recurring confirmed pattern into a guard rule with benign counterexamples

donors.mechanism: pre-execution destructive command interception, rule packs, explainable deny and safer alternatives
donors.claim_boundary: DCG covers its declared command/effect patterns; Rising Sea-specific ruin classes require explicit residual rules.

donors.mechanism: mechanical capability typestate, default deny, zone isolation and truthful runtime resolution
donors.claim_boundary: FCP is the authority architecture donor; Rising Sea does not claim FCP is integrated until an adapter receipt exists.

donors.mechanism: SPIFFE identity + OPA policy + exact human authority separation
donors.claim_boundary: Identity, policy, approval and effect remain distinct state objects.
